title: Siege of Stralsund (1711–1715)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Stralsund (1711–1715)", at revision 1382484142, opens: "The siege of Stralsund was an armed engagement during the Great Northern War. The Swedish Empire defended her Swedish Pomeranian port of Stralsund against a coalition of Denmark-Norway, the Electorate of Saxony and the Tsardom of Russia, which was joined by the Kingdom of Prussia during the siege." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q571699, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "series of sieges of Stralsund between 1711 and 1715". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
